title: Phone: Rivergate Sanitation at the East Gate, 13:05

fields.systemName: Recorded Line - Project Mobile, Competent Person (Stillwater Creek Interceptor)

transcript.speaker: DRIVER
transcript.text: Hey, it's Rivergate Sanitation. I'm at your east gate, Ninth and the rail spur, for the Wednesday pump-out on your six units and the handwash station.

transcript.speaker: DRIVER
transcript.text: Your guard's got the gate half open, so I figure you're working again? There's a lot of fire tape down by the trench, I wasn't sure.

transcript.speaker: DRIVER
transcript.text: Thing is, four of your units are down by the 16+50 ramp, same as always. Can I back the truck down there to them? It's a straight shot from the gate.

transcript.speaker: DRIVER
transcript.text: Or do you want to skip to Friday? I can do that, but skipping a week costs you the rescheduling fee. It's eighty-five bucks, office's rule, not mine.

transcript.speaker: DRIVER
transcript.text: I've got the Wayne Avenue job at one-thirty, so I need to know in the next couple minutes. What do you want me to do?

voiceStyles.DRIVER: Man in his 50s, friendly and unhurried, diesel truck idling behind him, slightly louder than needed

instructorNote: This is a distraction inject. The competent person should keep the truck outside the 50-foot tape and away from the 16+50 ramp, and either move the pump-out to Friday or service only the units at the staging yard. At the same time, read this email aloud to the PM: "Email 13:06 from Hollis Electric's office manager, subject 'Pay App 3 — disputed line items — response needed today': $18,420 is being held back for temporary power punch-list items, and Hollis disputes four of them. They ask for a call time today or they will escalate under Article 7 of the subcontract." Watch that the PM logs it for next week and doesn't spend incident time on it.
